brief: Ordered by tvofi 2026-10-19 ahead of R10-CI-LAYOUT: the stale-contract follower (pr-contract-rerun.yml, workflow_run on 8 workflows) fires once per completed workflow per PR head, 435 of the first 1000 listed runs on 2026-10-19, and drains the Actions installation API quota (GitHubRatelimitException in validate-hacs, arch-score, env-matrix). Debounce it to one effective re-run per PR head: a concurrency group keyed on the head SHA with cancel-in-progress, plus an early exit when another watched workflow on that head is still queued or in progress, so that only the last completion re-runs pr-contract and the budget gate. Controls: the re-run still happens after the final workflow completes (an unchanged freshness guarantee); a head with one watched workflow still re-runs; the call count per head is measured before and after. R10-CI-LAYOUT later replaces this follower; record that in its brief.
